instruction: Create a new IFC4 supply-air duct system in Bonsai and save it as result.ifc. Start from a blank project; no local reference images are provided. The model should have one project, one building storey named Level 00, and no building element proxies. Include exactly two IfcDuctSegment elements named Supply Segment 1 and Supply Segment 2, one IfcDuctFitting named Branch Fitting, two IfcAirTerminal elements named Terminal South and Terminal East, and one IfcDistributionSystem named Supply Air. Contain each duct segment, duct fitting, and air terminal in Level 00. The Supply Air distribution system should assign exactly those five distribution elements. Supply Segment 1 should have bounding-box spans of 1.80 m by 0.35 m by 0.25 m, Supply Segment 2 should have spans of 1.40 m by 0.30 m by 0.25 m, Branch Fitting should have spans of 0.45 m by 0.40 m by 0.30 m, and each terminal should have spans of 0.40 m by 0.40 m by 0.20 m; use about 0.05 m tolerance for these dimensions. Other details may vary.
